paywall_config.description: Paywall words only: headline per source, five feature points, buttons (Continue for monthly, Start Free Trial for yearly with a real trial), fine print, per-month label. Prices and trial length come from the store.

paywall_offers.description: Store product ids of the plans sold (yearly, monthly) and the free-trial switch/days. No discount or returning-user offers. Missing fields keep the app's built-in values.

onboarding_config.description: Text and on/off switch for the single onboarding screen (enabled, title, subtitle, button_text). A text equal to the English default is shown translated; a changed text is shown as written. The image is bundled in the app.

cro_limits.description: OLD free limits, kept only for the released app build. The new build reads plan_limits first.

cro_triggers.description: Turn each paywall source on or off (onboarding, scan_warning, scan_limit, ai_limit, pro_template, pro_qr, watermark, clixa_limit, crown, settings). The limit itself still applies when its paywall is off.

onboarding_enabled.description: OLD on/off switch for onboarding, kept only for the released app build. The new build reads onboarding_config.enabled first.

plan_limits.description: What each plan may do (free, trial, monthly, yearly). -1 = unlimited. Pro (trial, monthly, yearly; weekly reads the same): Clixa AI chats 5 per week. Read first; cro_limits is only the fallback.
